name: Gallabox
tagline: An affordable Indian WhatsApp commerce platform with genuinely broad ecommerce-and-payments integrations — and a real, unresolved question mark over customer support quality.
tldr: Gallabox was founded by Karthik Jagannathan, Yogesh Narayanan, and Yathindhar Panchanathan around 2020-2021 (sources conflict on exact year and even city, variously citing Chennai and Bengaluru), and has raised $8.26M total across three rounds, most recently a 2025 seed extension led by FUSE with Prime Venture Partners and Neon Fund participating.

Pricing is genuinely affordable and tiered: Starter ~$23/mo (3 users, single WhatsApp number), Growth ₹1,999/mo, Scale ₹3,999/mo, Pro ₹6,999/mo (10 agents, ChatGPT integration, API access), with Enterprise custom-priced — WhatsApp's own per-message fees apply separately on all tiers.

Integration breadth is a genuine standout for a tool at this price point, and distinctively includes both Shopify and WooCommerce alongside India-specific business tools: Razorpay (payments), Shiprocket (shipping), Zoho Books (accounting), and Google Sheets.

AI capability includes an AI Copilot and chatbot tools, with ChatGPT integration specifically gated to the Pro tier and above — real but not deeply documented with the technical specificity some competitors publish.

Review sentiment is genuinely strong in aggregate (4.6/5 across 168 G2 reviews), but a specific, credible, and directly contradictory complaint pattern exists in individual reviews describing customer support as effectively nonexistent ('no one is there to help if you [are] facing any issue') — a real discrepancy worth investigating directly.

Best for budget-conscious Indian SMBs and ecommerce sellers wanting broad, locally-relevant integrations (Razorpay, Shiprocket) at an affordable price — not for teams that need guaranteed, verified support responsiveness given the mixed signal in independent reviews.
keyFeatures: A collaborative shared dashboard unifying WhatsApp, email, and live chat conversations for team access
AI Copilot and chatbot tools for automated customer communication, with ChatGPT integration on Pro tier and above
500+ pre-built WhatsApp message templates for fast, compliant messaging
Automated responses, drip campaigns, and scheduled messaging for proactive customer engagement
Native integrations spanning Shopify, WooCommerce, Razorpay (payments), Shiprocket (shipping), Zoho Books, and Google Sheets — 30+ integrations total
CRM and contact-management features for storing and organizing customer records
API access for custom development, available from the Pro tier
Multiple support channels documented (email/help desk, FAQs/forum, knowledge base, chat), though independent reviews describe mixed real-world responsiveness

faq.question: How much does Gallabox actually cost?
faq.answer: It's genuinely affordable at entry: roughly $23/month (Starter, 3 users, single WhatsApp number), scaling through Growth (₹1,999/mo), Scale (₹3,999/mo), and Pro (₹6,999/mo, 10 agents with ChatGPT integration and API access), with custom Enterprise pricing above that. WhatsApp's own per-message fees apply separately on every tier, and additional users, extra WhatsApp numbers, and Shopify access can add meaningfully to the base plan cost.

faq.question: Is Gallabox's customer support actually good or bad?
faq.answer: This is genuinely unclear from public review evidence, and worth being direct about the contradiction. The aggregate rating is strong (4.6/5 across 168 G2 reviews, with support specifically cited as a strength in some reviews), but other individual reviews describe support as effectively nonexistent, with one stating plainly that 'no one is there to help if you [are] facing any issue.' This kind of split suggests support quality may vary significantly by plan tier or account manager — ask for specific, current references before committing to a paid plan if support responsiveness matters to you.

faq.question: Does Gallabox integrate with WooCommerce as well as Shopify?
faq.answer: Yes, and this is a genuine differentiator — many India-origin WhatsApp commerce tools in this category focus on Shopify alone, but Gallabox documents both Shopify and WooCommerce as native integrations, alongside India-specific business tools like Razorpay for payments and Shiprocket for shipping.

faq.question: How sophisticated is Gallabox's AI?
faq.answer: Real but modestly documented — an AI Copilot and chatbot tools handle customer communication, with ChatGPT integration specifically available from the Pro tier up. There's less technical detail publicly available about training methods or hallucination safeguards than some competitors publish, and no independently audited resolution-rate figure exists.

faq.question: Does Gallabox support channels beyond WhatsApp?
faq.answer: Email and live chat are documented alongside WhatsApp, but this remains a narrower channel scope than broader omnichannel competitors like Respond.io or Trengo that support 7-12+ channels including social DMs and voice.

faq.question: Who is Gallabox actually a good fit for?
faq.answer: Budget-conscious Indian SMBs and ecommerce sellers who want broad, locally-relevant integrations — particularly Razorpay and Shiprocket, which few global competitors document — at an affordable entry price. It's a less obvious fit for teams that need guaranteed, verified support responsiveness, given the genuinely mixed signal in independent reviews on that specific point.

pricingBreakdown: Gallabox's entry pricing is genuinely affordable — roughly $23/month for a 3-user Starter plan with 30+ integrations and 500+ WhatsApp templates already included is competitive against most tools in this category. The tier structure scales sensibly through Growth, Scale, and Pro, with ChatGPT integration and API access reserved for the Pro tier specifically. As with every WhatsApp Business API platform in this comparison, plan fees are separate from WhatsApp's own per-message costs, which shifted to per-message billing based on message category and recipient country code — factor this in as a genuinely separate, usage-scaling cost layer. Additional users, extra WhatsApp numbers, and Shopify access can add meaningfully to the base plan cost, so model your real team size and integration needs before assuming the entry-tier price represents your total bill.

verdict: Gallabox earns real credit for something few competitors in this specific niche offer: genuine integration breadth for Indian ecommerce sellers specifically, with both Shopify and WooCommerce alongside Razorpay for payments and Shiprocket for shipping — tools that matter enormously to that exact buyer and that most global competitors don't bother supporting. Combined with genuinely affordable entry pricing (roughly $23/month) and a substantial template library included from the start, this is a well-thought-out product for its target market, and the aggregate review score (4.6/5 across 168 G2 reviews) backs that up in broad strokes. What I have to flag directly, though, is a real contradiction sitting underneath that aggregate number: specific individual reviews describe customer support as effectively nonexistent — 'no one is there to help if you [are] facing any issue' — which sits in genuine tension with the platform's own claim of a similarly-rated support experience. I can't resolve that contradiction from public review data alone, and neither should you; it's the kind of discrepancy that often reflects real variance by plan tier or account relationship, and it's worth getting current, specific references before committing serious volume to this platform. The AI capability itself is real but modestly documented, without the technical specificity or independent verification some competitors provide. My honest read: if Gallabox's specific integration list (Shopify/WooCommerce plus Razorpay/Shiprocket) matches your exact stack and the affordable price is a real draw, it's worth evaluating — but push directly on support responsiveness during your trial period rather than assuming the aggregate rating tells the whole story.
